# MeowTrail Wiki — AI-Friendly Site Map
# https://meowtrail.org/llms.txt
# This file helps AI search engines understand and reference our content.

> MeowTrail Wiki is the definitive resource for MeowTrail (Akari/Light Up cat puzzle) by Oakever Games. Play free online, learn rules, master strategies, solve daily puzzles.

## Pages

- [Homepage](https://meowtrail.org/) — What is MeowTrail, quick start guide, download links
- [Play Online](https://meowtrail.org/play) — Free browser-based MeowTrail puzzle game with multiple difficulty levels and grid sizes
- [Rules](https://meowtrail.org/rules) — Complete rules and FAQ for MeowTrail/Akari puzzles
- [Tips & Strategy](https://meowtrail.org/tips) — Beginner, intermediate, and advanced solving strategies
- [Daily Puzzle](https://meowtrail.org/daily) — New puzzle every day, same for all players worldwide
- [Cheats & Solutions](https://meowtrail.org/cheats) — Hints, walkthroughs, and online solver tool


## Key Facts

- MeowTrail is developed by Oakever Games (Singapore, 1B+ downloads)
- Based on Akari (Light Up), a logic puzzle by Nikoli (Japan)
- Available on iOS (App Store) and Android (Google Play)
- Free to play with ads
- The puzzle involves placing light bulbs on a grid, following numbered clues
